$comment: How `gh` answers each WRITE operation — success and failure — modeled
faithfully on gh's real output formats so the app's mutation handling can
be exercised without mutating anything. The required suite must never
touch real GitHub (AGENTS.md), so these cases drive a scripted stand-in
`gh` in src-tauri/tests/github_cli.rs, through the production runner.
Provenance discipline: every case states where its format comes from.
`confidence: source-exact` means the format string was read from the gh
source for the pinned version; `confidence: modeled` means the wrapper
format is source-exact but the API-authored message text inside it is
known behavior that the supervised sandbox run re-captures verbatim
(docs/github-sandbox-runbook.md). A modeled case is a claim to verify,
not a fact — that is what the live suite is for.

basis.mergeMessages: cli/cli v2.95.0 pkg/cmd/pr/merge/merge.go — success `%s %s pull request %s#%d (%s)`, auto-merge `%s Pull request %s#%d will be automatically merged%s when all requirements are met`, refusal `%s Pull request %s#%d is not mergeable: %s.` with reasons from blockedReason(); success/refusal lines print to stderr; failure icon is ASCII `X`
basis.graphqlErrors: cli/go-gh pkg/api/errors.go — `GraphQL: %s` joined with `, `, each message suffixed ` (%s)` with the mutation path
basis.httpErrors: cli/go-gh pkg/api/errors.go — `HTTP %d: %s (%s)` with the request URL
basis.exitCodes: gh help exit-codes — 0 ok, 1 error, 4 authentication failure
